scripts.build: pnpm --filter @botiverse/raft build && tsup && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('../cli/dist','dist/cli',{recursive:true})" && node scripts/write-dist-bins.mjs
scripts.release:patch: node scripts/release-runtime-sdk-preflight.mjs && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && cd ../.. && pnpm install --lockfile-only && git add packages/daemon/package.json packages/daemon/runtime-sdk-release-preflight.json pnpm-lock.yaml packages/shared/src/piBuiltinModels.generated.ts packages/shared/src/generated/runtimeProviderDisplayNames.ts && git commit -m "chore: bump @botiverse/raft-daemon to v$(node -p "require('./packages/daemon/package.json').version")" && git tag daemon-v$(node -p "require('./packages/daemon/package.json').version") && git push && git push --tags
